entries.title: Psalms 26:1
segments: A Psalm of David. Judge me, O LORD; for I have walked in my truthfulness. I have trusted also in the LORD; I shall not slide.

entries.title: Psalms 26:2
segments: Examine me, O LORD, and prove me; purify my heart and my mind.

entries.title: Psalms 26:3
segments: For Your loving-kindness [is] before my eyes; and I have walked in Your truth.

entries.title: Psalms 26:4
segments: I have not sat with lying men, neither will I go in with hypocrites.

entries.title: Psalms 26:5
segments: I have hated the congregation of evil-doers, and will not sit with the wicked.

entries.title: Psalms 26:6
segments: I will wash my hands in innocency; so I will go around Your altar, O LORD,

entries.title: Psalms 26:7
segments: so that I may cry out with the voice of thanksgiving, and tell of all Your wonderful works.

entries.title: Psalms 26:8
segments: LORD, I have loved the dwelling place of Your house, and the place where Your honor dwells.

entries.title: Psalms 26:9
segments: Do not take away my soul with sinners, nor my life with bloody men

entries.title: Psalms 26:10
segments: in whose hands [is] a plot, and their right hand is full of a bribe.

entries.title: Psalms 26:11
segments: But I will walk in my truthfulness; redeem me and be merciful to me.

entries.title: Psalms 26:12
segments: My foot stands in an even place; in the congregations I will bless the LORD.
